ClientProfile.title: Traveler Client Profile
ClientProfile.description: Cloud-synced traveler account with OTP verification state, Visa/Tasheer order tracking, passport metadata, and Google Drive document references.

phone.description: Normalized WhatsApp phone digits serving as unique client key.

orderCode.description: Deterministic non-PII order code for quick order status lookup (e.g. MSK-5002428).

accountType.description: Account classification separating individuals from corporate B2B partners.

companyName.description: Registered company or agency name for B2B Partner accounts.

contactPersonName.description: Designated manager/contact person name for B2B Partner accounts.

lastSeenAt.description: ISO timestamp of last active heartbeat or graceful disconnect.

avatarUrl.description: Google Drive direct HTTPS download URL for personal profile avatar.

avatarStoragePath.description: Google Drive file reference (gdrive:{fileId}) for client avatar.

avatarSizeBytes.description: Recorded compressed avatar size in bytes for Storage quota tracking.

otpGeneratedAt.description: ISO timestamp when current 6-digit OTP was generated.

otpExpiresAt.description: ISO timestamp (24h validity) when current 6-digit OTP expires.

otpConsumed.description: Whether the current OTP has been consumed or invalidated.

activatedByAdmin.description: Whether the account was instantly activated by Admin without requiring OTP.

adminBypassOtpAt.description: ISO timestamp of latest Admin instant activation without OTP.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of client 6-digit quick-login PIN.

pinUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when client PIN was created or updated.

trustedDevices.description: Bounded list (max 15) of trusted device fingerprints authorized for quick PIN login.

pendingLoginRequests.description: Bounded list (max 10) of new-device login approval requests sent to the client's previously trusted device.

pendingDevices.description: Bounded list (max 15) of pending new-device login approval requests mirrored on the client document.

activeSessions.description: Bounded list (max 20) of currently connected device sessions (trusted permanent or temporary with expiresAt).

blockedDevices.description: Bounded list (max 25) of deviceIds blocked by the client.

verified.description: Whether the client account has been verified.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of latest profile modification.

orderStatus.description: Current processing stage for Visa or VFS Tasheer appointment.

adminNotes.description: Client-visible note written by General Manager or Sub-Admin.

passportNumber.description: Uppercase passport number (manual or AI OCR extracted).

passportFullName.description: Full name matching the passport MRZ/data page.

passportFullNameEn.description: English full name as printed on passport (AI OCR or manual).

passportFullNameAr.description: Arabic full name as printed on passport if available.

visaDocumentNumber.description: Extracted Saudi visa or visit invitation document number.

saudiSponsorId.description: Extracted Saudi host/sponsor National ID, Iqama ID, or Establishment number.

sponsorName.description: Extracted host or sponsor name from the visa/visit document.

sponsorPhone.description: Extracted host or sponsor phone number from the visa/visit document.

visaApplicationValidUntil.description: Expiration date of the Saudi visa document submission validity (YYYY-MM-DD).

applicantNameAr.description: Extracted applicant Arabic name from visa/visit document.

applicantNameEn.description: Extracted applicant English name from visa/visit document.

documentPassportNumber.description: Passport number printed on the visa/visit document.

portOfEntry.description: Extracted arrival/consulate port of entry (e.g. Cairo, Alexandria).

visitorsList.description: List of travelers/visitors requested in the Saudi visit visa application.

documents.description: Bounded list (max 30) of uploaded document metadata with Google Drive download & view URLs.

familyMembers.description: Bounded list (max 25) of family members and companions with passport details and permanent Google Drive URLs for passport and personal photos.

issuedDocuments.description: Bounded list (max 30) of completed execution deliverables (PDF tickets, visas, Tasheer/GAMCA slips) issued by admin.

notifications.description: Bounded list (max 30) of real-time client notifications for issued documents and order status updates.

appointmentDetails.description: Structured booked appointment metadata (serviceType, date, time, location, referenceNumber) used for the client's high-contrast Appointment QR Pass.

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) device registration token for instant Web/Mobile Push Notifications.

fcmTokens.description: Bounded list (max 10) of active FCM device tokens registered across the client's phone & browsers.

fcmUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the client's FCM push token was last registered or refreshed.

pushNotificationsEnabled.description: Whether the client has granted push notification permission on their device.

SiteGeneralConfig.title: Site General Configuration
SiteGeneralConfig.description: Global announcement banner, dynamic phone number, working hours, and hero highlight overrides.

announcementEnabled.description: Controls visibility of the top urgent announcement banner.

primaryDriveWebAppUrl.description: Primary HTTPS Google Drive Web App script endpoint URL for cloud uploads.

additionalDriveWebApps.description: Bounded list (max 10) of secondary/scoped Google Drive Web App endpoints for multi-account failover or workload separation.

fcmVapidKey.description: Optional Firebase Cloud Messaging Web Push VAPID public key.

retentionDays.description: Saved attachment retention period in days (30, 60, or 90) for completed orders cleanup.

geminiApiKey.description: Persistent Gemini API key saved by the General Manager for Smart Passport Reader and document clarity checks across web and mobile builds.

SiteCmsState.title: Site Live Inline CMS State
SiteCmsState.description: Live inline editor text overrides, deleted block keys, and dynamically added custom service cards.

textOverrides.description: Map of scoped language:key text overrides.

deletedKeys.description: Bounded list of soft-deleted editable block keys.

customItems.description: Bounded list of dynamically added CmsCustomItem cards.

AdminAccount.title: Admin & Sub-Admin Account
AdminAccount.description: Master General Manager PIN hash and Sub-Admin accounts with granular role permissions.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the admin PIN.

fcmToken.description: Primary Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) device registration token for instant Admin/Manager Push Notifications.

fcmTokens.description: Bounded list (max 10) of active FCM device tokens registered across the Admin's phone & desktop browsers.

fcmUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Admin FCM token was last updated.

pushNotificationsEnabled.description: Whether the Admin has enabled instant Push Notifications on their device.

OrderStatusLookup.title: Public Non-PII Order Status Lookup
OrderStatusLookup.description: Isolated non-PII status projection containing only order code, general execution state, and deliverable availability.

ChatThread.title: Private Real-Time Chat Thread
ChatThread.description: Thread metadata and unread counters isolated per client or B2B partner phone ID.

ChatMessage.title: Private Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Individual message with optional compressed Google Drive attachments and read-receipt flags inside /chats/{phoneId}/messages/{messageId}.

NotificationSettings.title: Global Notification Settings
NotificationSettings.description: Canonical global FCM token registry (settings/notifications) holding adminFcmTokens for instant background push notifications.

adminFcmTokens.description: Bounded list (max 20) of active Admin & General Manager FCM device registration tokens.

DeviceApproval.title: New Device Login Approval Request
DeviceApproval.description: Real-time cross-device login approval record inside /deviceApprovals/{requestId}.

AnalyticsDaily.title: Daily Visitor Analytics
AnalyticsDaily.description: Daily unique visitor analytics tracking total, app, and web counts.

/clients/{phoneId}.description: Traveler & B2B partner profiles keyed by normalized WhatsApp phone digits.

/order_status/{phoneId}.description: Public non-PII order status lookup records exposing only general execution stage.

/site_config/{configId}.description: Public site configuration documents ('general' for SiteGeneralConfig, 'cms' for SiteCmsState).

/admins/{adminId}.description: Master General Manager config ('master') and Sub-Admin permission accounts.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Canonical settings document ('notifications') holding adminFcmTokens for background push delivery.

/chats/{phoneId}.description: Private chat thread summaries isolated per client/B2B partner phoneId.

/chats/{phoneId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection of private real-time chat messages and Drive attachment references.

/analytics_daily/{date}.description: Daily unique visitor tracking aggregated per calendar date.

/analytics_summary/{summaryId}.description: All-time aggregate visitor counts across platforms.
